Spill (https://www.spill.chat/) | Senior I Product Engineer (£84-101k) Senior II Backend Engineer (£108-121k) | London, UK (HQ) | ONSITE | Full-time

Our mission is to make talk therapy free at the point of use for as many people as possible. Right now, we're doing this by selling a mental health support product to businesses. We're a small product-focused company and were cashflow positive in 2025.

If you're interested in the mission and one of the roles, email calvin[at]spill[dot]chat with your CV
